description: List plans for a destination, cheapest first, single-country plans before multi-country ones. Filter by trip length, minimum GB, and plan type.

destination.description: Required. Country name (any supported language) or ISO alpha-2 code. A country with no dedicated plan returns an error, never plans for a different country.

lang.description: Language for names and for the purchase page. Default en when omitted. The language never changes which plan or what price is returned: every plan carries price_jpy and price_usd (both always present).

min_days.description: Trip length. Fixed-GB plans shorter than this are skipped; daily plans get the trip total.

min_gb.description: Minimum GB (daily allowance for daily plans).

plan_type.description: "data" = fixed GB for the whole period, "unlimited" = priced per day. Omit to include both types.

name: search_plans
title: Search plans
